title: IridiumX
description: A high-performance modpack designed to boost FPS, reduce lag, and keep Minecraft smooth without changing the core gameplay.
body:
# ⚡ IridiumX --- ### **Warning!** > _**Currently in Development, May have issues**_ --- **IridiumX** is a clean and optimized performance modpack built to make Minecraft run smoother, faster, and more stable — without changing the vanilla feel. Whether you're on a low-end PC or just want extra FPS, IridiumX focuses on removing lag and improving overall performance while keeping the game simple and familiar. ---

--- ## 🚀 Features - ⚡ Significant FPS boost - 🧠 Optimized memory and CPU usage - 🪶 Lightweight and fast-loading - 🎮 Vanilla-friendly (no gameplay changes) - 🔧 Carefully selected performance mods - 📉 Reduced stuttering and lag spikes --- ## 🖥️ Usage - Players with low-end or mid-range PCs - Anyone wanting smoother gameplay - People who prefer vanilla Minecraft but faster --- ## 📦 Contents IridiumX includes a collection of trusted performance mods that improve: - Rendering performance - Chunk loading - Memory handling - General game optimization All mods are chosen to work well together with minimal issues. --- ## ⚙️ Goals - Keep Minecraft **simple** - Improve **performance** - Maintain **stability** - Avoid unnecessary features --- ## ❗ Notes - This is a **performance-focused modpack**, not a content modpack - No new items, mobs, or mechanics are added - Works best with updated drivers and allocated RAM --- ## 💡 Tip For best performance: - Allocate 2–4GB RAM - Use updated Java - Close background apps
